book.name: Ola Saam
book.title: Ola Saam Ola Song En Preya Langa God

content: God im gudbinji langa im pipul

content.text: Preisim YAWEI det trubalawan God!
Im gudbinji langa ol detlot pipul hu weship langa im,
en hu teiknodis langa ol im lowa gudbinjiwei.
Ola bigininimob blanga detlot pipul garra jidan strongbalawan langa olabat kantri,
dumaji YAWEI im gibit ebrijing langa ol detlot bigininimob hu bulurrum im.
Olabat garra jidan ritjwan garram ebrijing,
en olabat garra oldei jidan trubalawei.
Wen ol detlot pipul na jidan langa dakbala pleis,
God garra jandim lait langa olabat jis laik wen det san gidap,
dumaji olabat jidan brabli kainbalawei,
en abum soribalawan filing en jidan gudbinjiwei.
Ol detlot hu gibitat enijing gudbinjiwei,
en hu nomo ad garram olabat mani,
en hu dum ebrijing trubalawei,
olabat na garra abum brabli gudwan laif.
Trabul kaan kaman langa olabat, najing.
Nobodi kaan foget blanga ola kainbalawan ting weya deibin oldei dumbat.
Dei nomo bradin blanga gedim bednyus.
Olabat jidan strongwan langa YAWEI en trastim langa im.
Olabat nomo jinggabat blanga enijing,
en nomo bradin du.
Olabat sabi brabliwei olabat enamimob kaan win, najing.
Olabat garra oldei jidan trubalawei.
Detlot najalot pipul garra toktokbat olataim blanga olabat,
dumaji deibin oldei dumbat ola gudwan ting blanga ola powan pipul.
Wen ola nogudwan pipul garra luk,
olabat garra barn binji brabliwei blanga tharran,
en dei garra kipgon lagijat raidap olabat binij.
Olabat kaan gedim detlot ting weya deibin wandimbat brabliwei.
